summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A. furnished a Form 6-K reporting its fiscal-period results under Section 63 of the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange regulations. The filing discloses a quarterly loss of ARS 6,380 million versus a prior-year gain of ARS 217,952 million, driven by fair-value losses on investment properties, alongside equity details and a market capitalization of roughly USD 1,178 million as of September 30, 2026. Cresud holds 55.14% of capital net of treasury shares. This is a routine earnings and shareholder-structure disclosure, not a special situation; no transactional event, premium, or deal mechanics are present.
